messages:
alice_support: Customer reports no free-trial credits after signup. They completed email verification but payment 3DS timed out during card add. Account acct_3745, email user@example.eu, region EU. User says they saw "no credits" on dashboard. Can payments team confirm gate reason?
liam_payments: payments-bot shows `3ds_result=TIMEOUT` and `risk_flag=cross_border_bin`. Promo eligibility is true but blocked by payment_method_gate. :eyes:
payments-bot: automated: payment_method_gate triggered -> reason=\"3ds_timeout\"; action=recommend_manual_review.
sara_research: @alice_support quick ask — did the user try reattempting 3DS or swapping card? any payment_attempt_id we can grep logs with?
alice_support: pasted minimal logs below for pay attempt (redacted):
```
signup_event: create account acct_3745
email_verified: true
payment_attempt_id: pay_20260315_02
3ds_result: TIMEOUT
ip: 3.82.200.12 (geolocate: US)
user_locale: en-IE
card_bin: 411111 (country=US)
promo_state: pending_gate
```
liam_payments: ok — notable mismatch: email domain suggests EU, IP resolves to US (likely VPN), card BIN US. Our gating policy requires either successful 3DS or card BIN region match for auto-grant. Timeout = gate.
ops_oncall: can we escalate or make a one-off? If legit user, we can manual grant and mark for fraud ops review. What do we need in audit?
alice_support: i've opened fraud ticket FR-8123 with attached logs and user confirmation they verified email. I'll request a manual grant if ops approves.
sara_research: for reproducibility: steps to repro that we should add to runbook — signup from EU account, tunnel outbound to US IP, attach US BIN and simulate 3DS failure. Will add test case.
ops_oncall: approve manual grant pending fraud triage. Use internal grant command and include ticket id.
alice_support: executing manual grant now (copying command so ops can see):
```
/grant_free_trial acct_3745 50 --reason "manual grant: 3DS timeout + ip/bin mismatch, email verified" --requester alice_support --ticket FR-8123
```
liam_payments: logged the grant in payments ledger. Also added flag `reviewed_by_fraud=true` on account. Please ping if user reports further payment issues.
alice_support: pinged user — they replied via DM: "I can see the 50 credits, thank you!"
ops_oncall: noted for audit. leaving a reminder for fraud team to follow up on FR-8123 and close after 24h. :thumbsup:
sara_research: added the repro snippet and suggested test to `inference-payments/runbook.md`.
alice_support: closing thread — user confirmed. thanks everyone.
